original.target_description: Study 1, post-training percent larger-later reward choice: immediacy-exposure (IE) versus no-training control (CONT), 15-s delay; generalized linear mixed-effects model contrast.

n.sample_role: Male Wistar rats in the two comparison groups; model also included 17 DE rats.
n.exclusions: One rat assigned to IE excluded because of persistent side bias; retained group sizes are 17 each.
n.location: HTML Introduction final paragraph (group assignment); Method, Subjects paragraph 1
n.quote: Rats were assigned to the DE (n=17), IE (n=17), or no-training control (CONT; n=17) groups in a way that minimized between-group differences in locomotor activity and pre-training levels of impulsive choice.

es.location: HTML Results, Figure 4 discussion, paragraph beginning Overall, DE training reduced impulsive choice; IE versus CONT at 15-s delay
es.quote: At the 15-s delay, IE training produced a near-significant difference in percent LLR choice relative to CONT rats (8.43% vs. 20.92%, respectively; z = 1.73, p = .08)

p.location: HTML Results, Figure 4 discussion, IE versus CONT at 15-s delay
p.quote: At the 15-s delay, IE training produced a near-significant difference in percent LLR choice relative to CONT rats (8.43% vs. 20.92%, respectively; z = 1.73, p = .08)

replication.target_description: Full text unavailable through permitted open routes; cached Springer text is an abstract/access page, not the complete paper. Title and DOI verified.

notes: Input has empty original and replication locators. Original full text verified against title and DOI. The neutral description identifies immediacy-exposure versus no-training control, but does not specify delay/test; the reported 15-s comparison is recorded with target_match unknown. The separate 30-s comparison is z = 1.08, p = .28 (Results, Figure 4 discussion). No across-delay IE-versus-CONT test is printed. Replication full text could not be obtained: supplied cache and DOI landing page contain only abstract/access text; Unpaywall and OpenAlex report no OA copy; Europe PMC has no matching record; author-linked OSF listing contains only ND 4 AUC.xlsx, ND4 Code.txt and ND 4 Data.csv, no manuscript; ResearchGate returned 403 and was not retried. Abstract group totals were not treated as analytic sample sizes. Reported success left unverified because the full replication paper was unavailable.
